response.sql: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, t.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins AS gap FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_wins > o.mean_avg_wins ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Records with zero losses have an undefined ratio and are excluded from that average.
